Island 2.2, design 2 of 3: a Z in book order

The three landmarks read as a Z, in book order. Tokenizer at the top left: its lower row, the four whole pieces TransBERT-bio-fr's tokenizer cut, runs straight on, level, into the last line of the batch that opens Pre-training at the top right: the same long, dot, long, dot, now with its first piece hidden. The batch is raised so that line sits on the row and scaled so its lines are as thick as the tokens. Pre-training's last output, the corrected TransBERT-bio-fr board, sends one round arrow down and back to the left, into the right edge of the same board in Fine-tuning, across the bottom, where the task cards plug in.

Footprint 903 × 1186 units, ratio 0.76 (width / height). Landmarks as validated, each drawn once, only scaled and placed: (a) at 0.300, (b) at 0.433, (c) at 0.360 of native. Draft (island-options/r1-2/option.py), 23 October 2026.
